title: This Stick Insect Is Nearly Two Feet Long

scenes.text: There is a stick insect nearly two feet long.
It lives on the island of Borneo.
A villager found it in 1989 and gave it to a naturalist.
It is named Chan's megastick, after him.
With its legs stretched out, it measures about twenty-two inches.
Its body alone is about fourteen inches.
It was the longest insect in the world, until a longer one turned up in China in 2016. Still nearly two feet.

description:
There is a stick insect nearly two feet long.
Chan's megastick from Borneo measures about 22 inches with its legs stretched out. It lost the world record in 2016 to an even longer species from China.
Would you keep one as a pet?
first_comment: Bonus: the record holder now is a Chinese species at about 24.6 inches. Which insect would you never want to meet?
